title: Calibeating Prediction-Powered Inference
abstract: arXiv:2604.21260v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study semisupervised mean estimation with a small labeled sample, a large unlabeled sample, and a black-box prediction model whose output may be miscalibrated. A standard approach in this setting is augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) [Robins et al., 1994], which protects against prediction-model misspecification but may be inefficient when the prediction score is poorly aligned with the outcome scale. We introduce Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference, which post-hoc calibrates the prediction score on the labeled sample before using it for semisupervised estimation. This simple step requires no retraining and can calibeat the original score, improving it both as a predictor of the outcome and as a regression adjustment for semisupervised inference. translated_title: 校准制胜的预测驱动推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究半监督均值估计问题，其设定包含一个小规模有标签样本、一个大规模无标签样本，以及一个输出可能未校准的黑箱预测模型。该设定下的标准方法是增广逆概率加权（AIPW）[Robins et al., 1994]，它能防范预测模型的错误设定，但当预测分数与结果尺度匹配不佳时可能效率低下。我们提出了校准预测驱动推断，该方法在将预测分数用于半监督估计之前，先在有标签样本上对其进行事后校准。这一简单的步骤无需重新训练，即可实现对原始分数的“校准超越”，既提升其作为结果预测器的表现，也改善其作为半监督推断中回归调整项的效果。我们研究了线性校准和保序校准。对于保序校准，我们建立了一阶最优性保证：保序后处理可以提升预测……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出校准预测驱动推断，仅需在有标签样本上对黑箱预测分数进行事后校准（无需重新训练），即可同时提升预测精度与半监督均值估计的效率，并为保序校准建立了一阶最优性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference, which post-hoc calibrates black-box prediction scores on a small labeled sample without retraining, improving both prediction accuracy and semisupervised mean estimation efficiency, with first-order optimality guarantees for isotonic calibration.
